answer: A farm thus burns the burn once for each duplicate self on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. The jetty debit happens at intake, kernel totals the burned amount, and vault anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 40 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. A farm of 64 pays that 227 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
